newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-RBA says RBA-govt agreement to help economy.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-RBA says RBA-govt agreement to help economy.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of Australia's new governor Ian Macfarlane said that central bank independence and the endorsement by the government of its inflation target will help to improve the medium term economic performance.
He also said that the government's recent budget will improve Australia's savings and growth performance.

"We are confident that the combination of central bank independence and an inflation target endorsed by the Government will help to improve Australia s medium-term economic performance on both inflation and long-term output growth," Macfarlane said in his maiden speech as governor.

On August 14, when the government announced the appointment of Macfarlane to replace the now retired Bernie Fraser, it issued "The Statement on Conduct of Monetary Policy" which stated its understanding of the high degree of independence given to the Reserve Bank.
It also endorsed the Reserve Bank's inflation target of 2.0 to 3.0 percent on average over the cycle.

"Similarly, on the fiscal policy side, the focus on the underlying deficit and the commitment to balance it over the cycle contained in the recent Budget will improve Australia s savings and growth performance in future years," he told a
The budget for the fiscal year to June 30, 1997, announced on August 20, slashed spending and halved the underlying budget deficit to A$5.3 billion from A$10.6 billion in 1995/96.
